name: grp-mcp
description: Drive an Acumatica ERP instance from Claude: read, write, run processes and diagnose failures across the five APIs Acumatica actually has. Talks to your own instance directly - nothing is proxied, and credentials never leave your machine. Writes are off per profile until you enable them, and a clean 'ok' is never trusted: writes are read back and anything unconfirmed is reported as unverified. Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux from PyPI through uvx, so it needs uv installed - 'winget install astral-sh.uv' on Windows, 'brew install uv' on a Mac. Run tools\Edit-Connections.cmd once to create your connections file; it lands in %USERPROFILE%\grp-mcp (~/.grp-mcp on macOS and Linux), outside AppData where a Claude app update cannot delete it, and the server finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.0-rc36): creating a numbering sequence reported a failure although the sequence was saved. After a save the tools compare what they wrote with what Acumatica stored, and a date Acumatica writes with a 12-hour clock (1/1/1900 12:00:00 AM) was compared as text, so 0.81.0-rc35 said the save had persisted nothing; any classic write that sets a record's key and a date could say the same. Dates now compare correctly, and a different date is still caught. If rc35 gave you that error, the sequence exists - check CS201010 rather than creating it again. Also, autofill no longer calls a single lookup candidate 'many matches' when it cannot read its id. Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
